title: Street Race Crew Manager
description: The user manages a street racing pit crew where RiggedFigure and Xbot are mechanics working on a CarConcept vehicle. Players drag crew members to repair stations around the car, assign tasks like tire changes and engine tuning, manage a shared energy pool that depletes with each action, and use undo/redo to optimize their strategy before the race timer expires.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Street Race Crew Manager game. Load three GLB assets: shared_assets/CarConcept.glb (a race car centered at origin), shared_assets/RiggedFigure.glb (crew member A, placed left of car), and shared_assets/Xbot.glb (crew member B, placed right of car). Camera: perspective at (0,5,10) looking at origin with OrbitControls. Lighting: ambient light (0.4 intensity) plus two directional lights from upper-left and upper-right. Ground plane with grid texture. Create 5 glowing repair stations (colored rings) around the car: Front Bumper, Rear Spoiler, Left Tires, Right Tires, Engine Hood. Display an HTML overlay HUD showing: shared Energy Pool starting at 100 units, individual task assignments for each crew member, a race countdown timer (90 seconds), repair progress bars for each station, and Undo/Redo buttons. Interaction: click a crew member to select them (outline highlight), then click a station to assign them there. The selected crew member lerp-animates to that station. Each repair task costs 10-20 energy from the shared pool (conservation law: total energy spent plus remaining always equals 100). Both crew members drawing from the same pool creates multi-input coupling. Each station takes 2 clicks to fully repair (crew member must be present). Track all actions in a history stack. Undo button reverses the last assignment, restoring energy and moving the crew member back. Redo re-applies undone actions. If both crew members are assigned to the same station simultaneously, repair speed doubles but energy cost increases by 50 percent (coupling penalty). Win condition: all 5 stations fully repaired before timer expires. Show win/lose modal. Minimum 10-14 steps required: select crew A, assign to station, select crew B, assign to different station, reassign members, undo a costly move, redo, complete all repairs. Add particle effects when a station completes repair.
